$comment: REQ-LOT-001: weighted random with pity/protection on some systems. Rarity weights live in rarities.json; this file holds the pity rules and the conversion values that keep a duplicate rare from feeling worthless (REQ-CRD-003).

pity.$comment: A counter of drops since the last item at or above the pity tier. On reaching the threshold the next drop is forced to that tier. Protects against a long unlucky run without making luck irrelevant.

bossCards.$comment: REQ-CRD-002: 0.5% from a boss, and each boss has its own pool. Duplicate protection is separate — see conversion below.

duplicateProtection.$comment: After this many boss kills with no card, the next kill guarantees one. The counter is per boss, so farming one boss cannot advance the pity on another.

conversion.$comment: REQ-CRD-003 / REQ-LOT-002: a duplicate must have a useful outcome. Dismantling yields crafting material; a duplicate boss card converts to a currency that buys a card of the player's choosing, which is what stops a 0.5% drop from ever being a dead end.
